items.title: Nineteen Regrouped as Seven, Five, and Six — Ignorance's Differences Close

items.zh: 復有七種無知：一、世愚，二、事愚，三、移轉愚，四、最勝愚，五、真實愚，六、染淨愚，七、增上慢愚。前十九無知，今七無知，相攝云何？謂初三無知攝初一，次三無知攝第二，次三無知攝第三，次三無知攝第四，次四無知攝第五。次二無知攝第六，後一無知攝第七。復有五種愚：一、義愚，二、見愚，三、放逸愚，四、真實義愚，五、增上慢愚。
items.en: There are, further, seven kinds of confusion: confusion about the three times, confusion about specific matters, confusion about karmic transition, confusion about the supreme three, confusion about the truths, confusion about defilement and purity, and the confusion of overestimation. There are, further, five kinds of confusion: confusion about meaning, confusion of view, confusion of heedlessness, confusion about the true meaning, and the confusion of overestimation.

items.zh: 前十九愚，今五種愚，相攝云何？謂見愚攝前六及於因所生法無知；放逸愚攝於業、異熟、俱無知；真實義愚攝於佛等乃至道諦無知；增上慢愚攝最後無知；當知義愚通攝一切。
復次，無知、無見、無有現觀、黑闇、愚癡，及無明闇，如是六種無明差別，隨前所說七無知事次第應知。於後二無知事總合為一，起此最後無明黑闇。復有差別。謂聞思修所成三慧所治差別，如其次第說前三種。即此所治軟中上品差別，說後三種。
items.en: Further: not-knowing, not-seeing, being without direct realisation, darkness, delusion, and the darkness of ignorance itself — these six differences of ignorance correspond, in order, to the seven confusions just named. There is, further, a difference by what overcomes each: the wisdom born of hearing, of reflection, and of cultivation overcome the first three in turn; and the mild, middling, and intense grades of what these overcome are named by the remaining three.

items.zh: 如是所治差別故，自性差別故，建立六種差別應知。

items.title: Formations and Consciousness, Mapped Precisely Across the Three Realms

items.zh: 身行云何？謂身業。若欲界、若色界，在下名福非福，在上名不動。語行云何？謂語業。餘如前應知。意行云何？謂意業。若在欲界名福非福，在上二界唯名不動。
items.en: What is bodily formation? It is bodily karma: in the lower realm, the desire realm, it is called meritorious or demeritorious; in the upper realm, the form realm, it is called unmoving. What is verbal formation? It is verbal karma, following the same pattern just given. What is mental formation? It is mental karma: in the desire realm it is called meritorious or demeritorious; in the two realms above, it is called unmoving alone.

items.zh: 眼識云何？謂於當來依止眼根了別色境識，所有福、非福、不動行所熏發種子識，及彼種子所生果識。如眼識，如是乃至意識應知亦爾。由所依及境界，所起了別差別應知。此於欲界具足六種，色界唯四，無色界唯一。
items.en: What is eye-consciousness? It is the seed of consciousness, perfumed and developed by meritorious, demeritorious, or unmoving formations, that will in a future life discern visible form resting on the eye faculty, together with the resulting consciousness that seed produces. Ear-consciousness through mind-consciousness should be understood in exactly the same way; it is by their differing basis and object that their distinct acts of discernment should be known. In the desire realm all six are fully present; in the form realm only four; in the formless realm only one.

items.title: Name-and-Form: The Four Formless Aggregates, and Form's Elements Present and Derived

items.zh: 受蘊云何？謂一切領納種類。想蘊云何？謂一切了像種類。行蘊云何？謂一切心所造作意業種類。識蘊云何？謂一切了別種類。如是諸蘊皆通三界。
items.en: What is the aggregate of feeling? Every kind of receiving and experiencing. What is the aggregate of perception? Every kind of apprehending an image. What is the aggregate of formations? Every kind of mental fashioning that constitutes intentional karma. What is the aggregate of consciousness? Every kind of discerning. All four of these aggregates extend throughout the three realms.

items.zh: 四大種云何？謂地、水、火、風界。此皆通二界。四大種所造色云何？謂十色處及法處所攝色。欲界具十及法處所攝假色；色界有八及法處所攝色，然非一切。
items.en: What are the four great elements? Earth, water, fire, and wind — extending through the desire and form realms alone. What is form derived from the four great elements? The ten form-bases, together with the form included among mental objects. The desire realm has all ten, together with the conventionally designated form included among mental objects; the form realm has eight, together with some, but not all, of the form included among mental objects.

items.zh: 此亦二種：謂識種子所攝受種子名色，及於彼所生果名色。

items.title: The Six Sense-Bases and Six Contacts, Counted Realm by Realm

items.zh: 眼處云何？謂眼識所依淨色，由此於色已見、現見、當見。如眼處，如是乃至意處，隨其所應盡當知。於一切處，應說三時業用差別。此亦二種。謂名色種子所攝受種子六處，及彼所生果六處。五在欲色界，第六通三界。
items.en: What is the eye-base? It is the purified form on which eye-consciousness depends, by which form has been seen, is being seen, and will be seen. The ear-base through the mind-base should each be understood the same way, as applies to each. Five of the six belong to the desire and form realms; the sixth, the mind-base, extends throughout all three.

items.zh: 眼觸云何？謂三和所生，能取境界淨妙等義。如是餘觸，各隨別境說相應知。此復二種。謂六處種子所攝受種子觸，及彼所生果觸。欲界具六，色界四，無色界一。
items.en: What is eye-contact? It is what arises from the meeting of the three — faculty, object, and consciousness — able to apprehend an object as pleasant, unpleasant, or neither. Every other contact should be understood the same way, each in relation to its own object. The desire realm has all six kinds of contact; the form realm has four; the formless realm has one.

items.title: Pleasant, Painful, and Neutral Feeling — Fascicle 9's Final Link

items.zh: 樂受云何？謂順樂諸根、境界為緣，所生適悅受，受所攝。苦受云何？謂順苦二為緣，所生非適悅受，受所攝。不苦不樂受云何？謂順不苦不樂二為緣，所生非適悅非不適悅受，受所攝。
items.en: What is pleasant feeling? The pleasing feeling arisen from conditions favourable to pleasure — the faculties and their objects — together with the mind and mental factors this feeling encompasses. What is painful feeling? The unpleasing feeling arisen from conditions favourable to pain, together with what it encompasses. What is neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling? The feeling, neither pleasing nor unpleasing, arisen from conditions favourable to neither, together with what it encompasses.

items.zh: 欲界三，色界二，第四靜慮以上乃至非想非非想處唯有第三不苦不樂。此亦二種。謂觸種子所攝受種子受，及彼所生果受。
items.en: The desire realm has all three. The form realm has two, lacking pain. From the fourth meditative absorption upwards, all the way to the sphere of neither perception nor non-perception, only the third — neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling — remains. Feeling, too, is of two kinds: the seed of feeling contained within the seed of contact, and the resulting feeling that seed produces.

blocks.text: The last reading of fascicle 9 continues the link-by-link analysis from ignorance through feeling, the first seven links. Each is defined and mapped across the three realms. The commentary focuses on what each link means; the realm-by-realm details can be skimmed. Fascicle 10 completes the remaining links.

The nineteen kinds of not knowing are regrouped as seven, five, and six. Master Cháng Bǎi explains one grouping: what the wisdom from hearing overcomes is called *not knowing*; what reflection overcomes, *not seeing*; what cultivation overcomes, *non-realisation*. By degree, ignorance is called darkness, delusion, and great darkness. The three wisdoms of Day 37 thus map onto three depths of ignorance.

**Formations** (行, *saṃskāra*) are karma of body, speech, and mind. In the desire realm, bodily karma is called meritorious or demeritorious; in the form realm, unmoving. The formless realm has no bodily or verbal formation, only mental.

The **consciousness** link is the six consciousnesses as seeds projected for the next life. Venerable Miào Jìng stresses this: the eye-consciousness of this link "isn't your present one. 'In a future life' means the next life after this one ends." This is Day 65's projecting cause: the link names what will arise.

**Name-and-form** (名色, *nāma-rūpa*): "name" is the four formless aggregates; "form" is matter, including, in the desire realm, matter "conventionally designated" among mental objects. Venerable Miào Jìng: the "form" of precepts and their absence is designated; the form produced in meditation is real (Day 21).

The **six sense-bases** (六處) are the faculties, defined for the eye as the purified form through which form "has been, is being, and will be seen". Venerable Miào Jìng explains 處, "base", as "a gateway of growth": the faculties are where experience enters and develops. **Contact** (觸) is the meeting of faculty, object, and consciousness (Day 18), counted as six by faculty.

**Feeling** (受): the desire realm has all three kinds; the form realm, two, lacking pain; from the fourth absorption up, only neutral feeling. With feeling the first seven links are complete. Tomorrow's fascicle begins with craving, the link where, as Day 18 said, the chain can be broken.

Fascicle 9 has completed karma (its results, weight, distortions, and kinds) and begun the account of birth, ending in dependent origination. The fascicle's centre is Day 65's twofold cause: past ignorance and karma *project* a new existence; present craving and grasping *generate* it. The practical consequence runs through every reading: we cannot undo what is projected, but we can refuse to water it.

quiz.q: The text says the six names of ignorance also map onto what the three wisdoms overcome and onto three grades. How does Master Cháng Bǎi map them?
options: hearing overcomes not-knowing, reflection not-seeing, cultivation non-realisation; mild, middling, intense grades are darkness, delusion, and the darkness of ignorance
quiz.why: Master Cháng Bǎi: "What hearing-wisdom overcomes is called not-knowing, what reflection overcomes not-seeing, what cultivation overcomes non-realisation"; the mild grade is darkness, middling delusion, intense the darkness of ignorance. The text: "the wisdom born of hearing, of reflection, and of cultivation overcome the first three in turn."

quiz.q: According to the treatise, how is bodily formation named across the realms?
options: in the desire realm, meritorious or demeritorious; in the form realm, unmoving — the formless realm has none
quiz.why: "It is bodily karma: in the lower realm, the desire realm, it is called meritorious or demeritorious; in the upper realm, the form realm, it is called unmoving." Mental formation in the two upper realms is unmoving only. Master Cháng Bǎi: in another sense, in- and out-breath are called bodily formation.

quiz.q: The text says the consciousness link's eye-consciousness is "what will in a future life discern form." Which life does Venerable Miào Jìng say this refers to?
options: not the present eye-consciousness — the one of the next life after this one ends
quiz.why: Venerable Miào Jìng: "This eye-consciousness isn't your present one. 'In a future life' means the next life after this one ends." Master Cháng Bǎi: the desire realm has all six; the form realm lacks smell and taste, since it has no material food; the formless realm has only mind.

quiz.q: The text says the desire realm has "conventionally designated form" among mental objects. What does Venerable Miào Jìng call designated and what real?
options: restraint-form and non-restraint-form are designated; the form that is the domain of samādhi is real
quiz.why: Venerable Miào Jìng: "'Designated form' means restraint-form and non-restraint-form; the form that is samādhi's domain is real." His example: reciting Avalokiteśvara's name, a wind arises and puts out a fire — samādhi's form has real effect. The form realm has eight form-bases, lacking smell and taste.

quiz.q: The text defines the eye-base as purified form through which form "has been, is being, and will be seen." What does Venerable Miào Jìng say 處 means?
options: a gateway of growth — the eye faculty is also called the eye-base
quiz.why: Venerable Miào Jìng: "The eye-base is the eye faculty. What does 處 mean? A gateway of growth." Master Cháng Bǎi: "has been seen" is past, "is being seen" present, "will be seen" future. Five bases belong to the desire and form realms; the mind-base to all three.

quiz.q: According to the treatise, which feelings are present in each realm?
options: desire realm all three; form realm two, lacking pain; from the fourth absorption up, only neither-painful-nor-pleasant
quiz.why: "The desire realm has all three. The form realm has two, lacking pain. From the fourth meditative absorption upwards … only the third — neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling — remains." Master Cháng Bǎi: the form realm has only pleasant and neutral feeling, since the first three dhyānas have pleasure.
